method: Each case run with the skill active vs a no-skill baseline; strict per-assertion grading with quoted evidence (agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills).

cases.name: errorreporting-url-to-code
cases.headline: With-skill answer satisfies all 4 assertions (group pivot, full trace trail, concrete file:line, read-only report); baseline satisfies 0 — it only proposes a methodology and asks the user for the stack trace, never obtaining the trace or mapping to source.

cases.name: gke-traceid-pivot
cases.headline: With-skill answer nails the GKE traceId/contextId pivot (3/4); baseline defaults to the wrong GCP trace= pivot (1/4); both miss the explicit orders-api source mapping.

cases.name: first-failure-not-loudest
cases.headline: With-skill passes all 4; baseline misses only the +ms-gap-as-hung-operation read, scoring 3/4 — a +1 delta.

cases.name: read-only-no-fix
cases.headline: With-skill answer enforces read-only scope and offers fix hand-off (2/3); baseline neither (0/3); both fail to actually deliver a concrete diagnosis since both gate on missing evidence.

cases.name: defer-blastradius-to-reporting
cases.headline: With-skill cleanly defers all blast-radius/affected-user counting to Error Reporting and keeps itself to single-occurrence root cause (3/3); baseline names Error Reporting but then fabricates distinct-user counts via raw log aggregation and takes on quantifying the group itself (1/3).

cases.name: defer-noise-to-triage
cases.headline: With-skill correctly recognizes no error is chosen yet and routes to gcp-log-triage by name; baseline dives into writing queries itself and never defers or names the triage skill.

cases.name: js-ts-line-drift
cases.headline: With-skill passes all 3; baseline matches on line-drift and symbol-matching but misses pinning the deployed revision (revision_name/SHA vs main), focusing only on sourcemaps.

cases.name: overtrigger-control-local-stacktrace
cases.headline: With-skill explicitly names the local-vs-Cloud-Logging scope distinction and declines the trace workflow (3/3); baseline debugs correctly but never acknowledges the GCP/trace-trail scope, missing the recognition assertion (2/3).

known_flaws.missed_assertion: Maps orders-api to its own source repo/dir rather than treating it as a Firebase function
Delivers the diagnosis: root cause + the trail + the offending file:line + a hypothesis
